vi.sub: Hien tai khong duoc phat hanh

zh.sub: 最新快照显示阻断条件已命中，当前禁止放行。
zh.firstAction: 先按 reasons 首项排障，再重跑 release-snapshot-latest。

en.sub: The latest snapshot contains blocking conditions, so release is blocked.
en.firstAction: Troubleshoot the first item in reasons, then rerun release-snapshot-latest.

vi.main: Trang thai snapshot moi nhat: BLOCKED
vi.sub: Snapshot moi nhat co dieu kien chan, vi vay phat hanh bi chan.
vi.firstAction: Xu ly muc dau trong reasons, sau do chay lai release-snapshot-latest.

conditions: decision is missing or decision not in ['GO','NO-GO']
exitCode is missing or exitCode not in [0,1]

zh.sub: 最新快照字段缺失、取值异常或决策与退出码不一致，无法直接用于放行。
zh.firstAction: 先重跑 release-snapshot 生成有效快照，再判定放行。

en.sub: Latest snapshot has missing/invalid fields or decision-exitCode mismatch, so it cannot be used directly for release.
en.firstAction: Rerun release-snapshot to regenerate a valid latest snapshot before deciding release.

vi.main: Trang thai snapshot moi nhat: UNKNOWN
vi.sub: Snapshot moi nhat thieu/sai truong hoac khong khop giua decision va exitCode, khong the dung truc tiep de quyet dinh phat hanh.
vi.firstAction: Chay lai release-snapshot de tao snapshot hop le truoc khi quyet dinh phat hanh.

zh.sub: 最新快照结论为 GO 且无阻断原因，可进入标准放行流程。
zh.firstAction: 先做发布窗口确认，再按标准步骤放行。

en.sub: Latest snapshot is GO with no blocking reasons, ready for standard release flow.
en.firstAction: Run release-window confirmation first, then proceed with standard release steps.

vi.main: Trang thai snapshot moi nhat: READY
vi.sub: Snapshot moi nhat la GO va khong co ly do chan, san sang cho quy trinh phat hanh chuan.
vi.firstAction: Xac nhan cua so phat hanh truoc, sau do phat hanh theo cac buoc chuan.
